entry.title: Welcome
entry.content:
Welcome to my website! I’m a developmental biologist studying how oocytes grow and how ovarian follicles develop. I’ll use this space to share research updates, new papers, and occasional notes on oocyte biology.

To write a new post, add a Markdown file to _posts/ named YYYY-MM-DD-title.md with a front-matter block like the one at the top of this file.
